This means a new "seize the day today" opportunity - for those who are curious or interested! 

If you have been thinking of securing your Original Steam Version copy of [b]Systematic Insanity[/b],
then - perhaps - NOW IS THE RIGHT TIME - to purchase, play and read this one-of-a-kind Visual Novel!

 Systematic Insanity features a [b]Cinematic Reading Experience. [/b]

 It is like reading a novel while simultaneously watching a movie.

  [b] SYSTEMATIC INSANITY HAS A ONE-OF-A-KIND BEAUTIFUL STORY [/b]
